Verification — what the deep round proved (2026-07-22)

WRITE-COST KEYSTONE PROVEN AT L1 (scratch-live-writecost). On a live scratch release (booted 14.4s warm via pds-scratch-target.sh): two pulses moved revisions 5→5, audit 5→5, mutation_events 6→8 (both new events exactly task.pulse) — the lean idiom is 0 revision / 0 audit / 1 event per beat. Two plain content writes moved revisions 2→4, events 2→4, audit 2→4 — 3 rows per plain write, as the digest predicted. Caveats inherited by the proof harness: bp task verbs 403 on a bare-token scratch server (flat routes + bearer token work — the harness must curl flat routes), and the Sanity-style patch envelope 400'd on that build (createOrReplace was the measured plain write).

ZERO-GO RENDERING PROVEN AT RUNTIME (cli-envelope-proof). A {"documents":[roster-row]} payload renders a real multi-column table (probe test output quoted in the report); a bespoke {"roster":[...]} key degrades to ONE crammed KV cell and also breaks extractListRows pagination. pickColumns will NOT lead with WORKER (status leads, worker sorts last) — WORKER-first is a cosmetic Go backlog item. Live corroboration: bp task ls -o json against production returns {"docs":[...]} and renders a real table today. NOT-FOUND: the assignment's charter path did not exist in git history anywhere — the epic brief's own pointer was stale (steward task fixes it). Orthogonal find: go test ./internal/cli hangs on macOS via a pre-existing captureExecuteCode pipe deadlock (ubuntu CI green) — filed pdf-bl-go-test-pipe-deadlock.

EVENT-CONSUMER CENSUS (mutation-events-consumers). insert_mutation_event! never reaches webhook dispatch (bare Repo.insert!; dispatch lives only in Content.Broadcast.tap_broadcast, which task-family writes never call). GitHub outbox, /v1/tasks/events and /v1/tasks/prime are all hard-scoped to type=="task" — safe iff listeners are NEVER task-typed. THE REAL LEAK: Sync.Outbox.fetch has NO type filter, and any non-"task."-prefixed mutation falls to push_doc = full createOrReplace to every push-enabled remote. Verdict adopted: a ZERO-new-row beat is possible and lower-risk (the roster reads last_seen off the doc; nothing needs beat events), plus a structural type!="listener" exclusion in Sync.Outbox for the remaining registration events. mutation_events is already 63k rows, unbounded, never purged — independent support for zero-row.

TENANCY RULING (tenancy-mount). Mount FLAT at /v1/fleet/* copying the task family exactly — which rides AssignDefaultScope (NOT DeriveWorkspaceFromToken; that plug lives only on cycle/media/search-admin pipelines — the digest's framing was half-wrong and is corrected). On a personal box multi_tenant? is false and dataset is the only live axis. The roster read copies Tasks.Board.snapshot: global-per-dataset, NO workspace clause — divergence structurally impossible; the workspace-filtered index shape would fail-close to EMPTY on a nil workspace. A socket-scoped (LiveScope) console read is forbidden; the console hits the same flat endpoint. The harness additionally asserts the survivor row is RETURNED (catches empty-read bugs the ONLINE assert would miss).

CHECKOUT STEWARD (checkout-steward). Local main: 8 ahead (all OTHER epics' charter commits — preserve, never drop) / 136 behind. tooling/fleet + both skills are ALREADY on origin/main via merged PR #5178, byte-identical to local untracked copies. Local HEAD's plugins/tasks.ex is 59 lines STALE vs origin/main — builders MUST worktree from freshly-fetched origin/main. The worktree-fleet-provider-neutral branch is dead/superseded (never merged, bp task closed). Two open unclaimed tasks name plugins/tasks.ex (dee92039…, 67477838…) — soft collision watch. Steward sequence filed as pdf-bl-checkout-steward.

AMENDMENT MAP (pdf-wave-a-amendment-map). Exact lines: fleet-listener SKILL.md L31-34 ('until that ships…'), fleet-orchestrator §0 L19-20 + §6 L99-115 with the Herd 'Native home' sentence at L112-114 directly contradicting ratified PDF-D12 (DELETE, not soften). fleet-run.sh insertion points L64/65 (start beat) and L69/70 (idle beat) — file has zero backgrounding today and must keep it (PDS-D243: nohup& dies to killpg ambiguously; setsid outlives the corpse). Staleness census: route.py _online (Python), chat_hosts online? (Elixir), plus the new roster module = the formula exists 3+ times across 2 languages → ONE canonical server-side module with an @canonical marker; route.py demoted to fallback.

Decisions — PDF-D16..D25 (charter is canonical; one-line whys here)

  • D16 LEDGER-NATIVE RECORD: type "listener", never "task" — the type literal IS the GitHub/task-events/prime exclusion.
  • D17 ZERO-ROW BEAT: one atomic update_all, server-stamped last_seen, lock family listener:<id>, no events/revisions/audit/broadcast — live-measured, nothing consumes beats.
  • D18 SYNC GUARD STRUCTURAL: type != "listener" in Sync.Outbox.fetch, own PR, protective test — Sync push has no type filter and push_doc would fan registrations to every remote.
  • D19 FLAT MOUNT + GLOBAL-PER-DATASET READ: AssignDefaultScope family; Board.snapshot shape; socket-scoped console reads forbidden.
  • D20 ONE STALENESS FORMULA: Barkpark.Tasks.Fleet computes status at read (@canonical fleet-presence-staleness); clients render, never recompute; task join = claim.worker || assignee.
  • D21 ZERO-GO SHIP: documents envelope + manifest-minted fleet.roster/fleet.beat; WORKER-first column = backlog.
  • D22 TTL FIXTURES: default 120s; runner beats ~6s/ttl 30; resident skill turn-boundary beats/ttl 900; sidecars stay banned (PDS-D243).
  • D23 ROW VOCAB: idle|working|blocked self-declared (+provisioning reserved Wave C); offline computed-only; empty/cap-hit/conflict are fleet-level.
  • D24 THE PROOF IS THE WAVE: scripts/pdf-kill-listener-proof.sh — kill one of two, survivor present+online, corpse offline at its TTL not before, --negctl proves the check can fail; transcript = criterion-0 evidence.
  • D25 STEWARD LAW: builders worktree from fresh origin/main only; dead branch never resurrected; charter PR'd to origin via pdf-bl-checkout-steward.

Wave plan — 4 slices, 3 rounds

  • R1 pdf-wa-server-presence (FABLE, large) — listener schema + Barkpark.Tasks.Fleet (zero-row beat, fail-closed roster) + /v1/fleet routes + fleet.roster/fleet.beat manifest + plugin.json noun + fleet_test.exs. Gate: cd api && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark/tasks/fleet_test.exs; merge waits CI Elixir Test.
  • R1 pdf-wa-sync-outbox-guard (OPUS, small) — type!=listener in Sync.Outbox.fetch + protective test. Gate: cd api && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark/sync/outbox_test.exs.
  • R2 pdf-wa-runner-skills-native-presence (OPUS, medium, AFTER server merges) — fleet-run.sh start/idle/transition beats in the single foreground loop; both SKILL.mds go native; Herd sentence deleted; route.py prefers server status. Gate: bash -n fleet-run.sh && python3 route.py (8/8).
  • R3 pdf-wa-kill-listener-proof (OPUS, medium, AFTER server+runner merge) — scratch-target harness, two curl-beating listeners ttl 10, kill one, offline in [ttl, ttl+3s] window, survivor returned+online, --negctl, teardown PASS, transcript committed. Gates: --plan / full / --negctl runs.

Wave complete SUPERSEDED 2026-07-22 (Review): the in-flight note that stood here is closed out — round 1 built, reviewed, and handed to the lead. The full story is in the Debrief below. Rounds 2-3 dispatch as their dependencies merge.

Debrief — Review complete (2026-07-22)

Round 1 (both slices) built green, was adversarially reviewed, fixed in place where the charter demanded it, and re-gated. Rounds 2-3 were NOT built this run BY DESIGN (sequenced-rounds law: they need round 1 merged). Wave grade: A−.

  • pdf-wa-server-presence — SHIPPED, final branch loop-epic/listener-presence-is-a-citizen-of-the-le-0-r (review commit cd0bffa04 on top of builder 0fc1069c3, pushed). Listener schema + Barkpark.Tasks.Fleet (zero-row CAS beat under the listener advisory-lock family, fail-closed roster with per-row ttl_s, claim.worker||assignee task join) + /v1/fleet/beat + /v1/fleet/roster on :token_root + fleet.roster/fleet.beat manifest verbs + plugin.json noun. Gate re-run on final state: 17/17. REVIEW FIX: the builder made provisioning beat-declarable, violating PDF-D23 (self-declared vocab is idle|working|blocked; provisioning is provisioner-written, Wave C). Fixed: beat rejects provisioning AND offline, roster still renders a stored provisioning row verbatim while fresh; CLI flag summary + schema descriptions corrected; two protective tests added.
  • pdf-wa-sync-outbox-guard — SHIPPED CLEAN, final branch loop-epic/sync-push-can-never-fan-a-listener-doc-t-1 (bddcbef31, pushed, zero review fixes). type != "listener" beside the source != "sync" echo-guard in Sync.Outbox.fetch/3, mutation-proven protective test (guard removed → test fails by id). Reviewer verified the SQL NULL edge is impossible: mutation_events.type is null:false by migration, so the != clause can never silently drop a NULL-typed event. Gate 3/3.

Ledger audit: both built tasks honest — evidence stamped per-criterion as work happened, merge-gated criterion left open, lifecycle in_progress; deferred R2/R3 tasks untouched at 0-met open; epic heartbeat current. Zero ledger lies found, zero mutations needed. One note for the lead: pdf-wa-sync-outbox-guard's claim has lapsed (claim: null while in_progress) — re-claim before close (task-lifecycle law: close needs the CURRENT claim's worker+epoch).

Grade: A− Genuinely strong: every charter decision (D16-D25) is traceable in code and pinned by a test that can fail — the zero-row beat is proven by row-count equality, staleness by injected clock against per-row ttl_s, the documents envelope by refuting the bespoke key, the outbox guard by mutation. Falls short of A: the review had to correct a real charter deviation (PDF-D23 status vocab), the registration race and worker-slug collisions ("a b" vs "a-b" fold to one row) are known-and-untested blind spots, and the wish's headline proof exists only as an injected-clock unit test until R3's live kill-harness lands.

Next wave / lead dispatch order: (1) PR + merge both R1 branches — presence slice waits on CI Elixir Test (repo law), the two are decoupled by design and merge in any order; lead closes each task's merge-gated criterion on merge. (2) Then dispatch pdf-wa-runner-skills-native-presence (R2 — needs the live fleet manifest). (3) After R2 merges, pdf-wa-kill-listener-proof (R3) — its transcript is the epic's criterion-0 evidence. Residue worth a later slice: registration-race test, slug-collision guard, roster pagination at non-personal scale, and the pdf-bl-checkout-steward PR that puts the charter on origin/main.
